description: Model usage for the Giant Swarm Agent Platform: tokens, estimated cost and latency for every call that goes through the agentgateway LLM listener. Needs llmRouting enabled in the platform values, and agents pointed at the listener. Agents that call the provider directly are invisible here.

panels.description: Every token the gateway proxied, all types and models.
panels.title: Tokens / s

panels.description: Estimated spend, from the gateway's price catalog. Zero can also mean unpriced: check the catalog lookup panel.
panels.title: Cost / hour

panels.description: Distinct agents that made a model call in the window.
panels.title: Agents calling

panels.description: Distinct models answered in the window.
panels.title: Models in use

panels.description: Non-2xx responses on the LLM listener. Provider errors and rate limits land here.
panels.title: Errors / s

panels.description: The `agent` label is the calling pod's ServiceAccount, resolved by source IP from the agentgateway controller's workload store. It is an accounting identity, not a verified one. `unknown` means the caller IP matched no known Pod.
panels.title: Tokens per second by agent

panels.description: Priced from the gateway's model catalog. An unpriced model contributes nothing here, so read this next to the catalog lookup panel.
panels.title: Estimated cost per hour by agent

panels.description: Totals for the selected time range, per agent and namespace.
panels.title: Tokens and cost by agent, over the window

panels.description: `gen_ai_response_model` is what the provider answered with. There is no alias layer: it is the model the agent asked for.
panels.title: Tokens per second by model

panels.description: Priced from the gateway's model catalog.
panels.title: Estimated cost per hour by model

panels.description: input, output, input_cache_read and input_cache_write. Anthropic counts the three input types separately, so input excludes cache traffic. A high cache-read share is prompt caching paying off: it is priced at a fraction of input.
panels.title: Tokens per second by type

panels.description: Cache reads over all cache-eligible input tokens. It falls to zero when prompt caching stops working.

targets.expr: sum(rate(agentgateway_gen_ai_client_token_usage_sum{gateway=~"$gateway", agent_namespace=~"$agent_namespace", agent=~"$agent", gen_ai_response_model=~"$model", gen_ai_token_type="input_cache_read"}[$__rate_interval])) / clamp_min(sum(rate(agentgateway_gen_ai_client_token_usage_sum{gateway=~"$gateway", agent_namespace=~"$agent_namespace", agent=~"$agent", gen_ai_response_model=~"$model", gen_ai_token_type=~"input|input_cache_read|input_cache_write"}[$__rate_interval])), 1)

panels.title: Cache read share of input tokens

panels.description: How long the provider takes to start answering. A rise here is what a user feels as a hanging agent.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (gen_ai_response_model, le) (rate(agentgateway_gen_ai_server_time_to_first_token_bucket{gateway=~"$gateway", agent_namespace=~"$agent_namespace", agent=~"$agent", gen_ai_response_model=~"$model"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (gen_ai_response_model, le) (rate(agentgateway_gen_ai_server_time_to_first_token_bucket{gateway=~"$gateway", agent_namespace=~"$agent_namespace", agent=~"$agent", gen_ai_response_model=~"$model"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Time to first token by model (p50 / p95)

panels.description: Whole model call, first byte of the request to last byte of the response. Streamed completions run long by design.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (gen_ai_response_model, le) (rate(agentgateway_gen_ai_server_request_duration_bucket{gateway=~"$gateway", agent_namespace=~"$agent_namespace", agent=~"$agent", gen_ai_response_model=~"$model"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (gen_ai_response_model, le) (rate(agentgateway_gen_ai_server_request_duration_bucket{gateway=~"$gateway", agent_namespace=~"$agent_namespace", agent=~"$agent", gen_ai_response_model=~"$model"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Request duration by model (p50 / p95)

panels.description: Streaming throughput after the first token.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (gen_ai_response_model, le) (rate(agentgateway_gen_ai_server_time_per_output_token_bucket{gateway=~"$gateway", agent_namespace=~"$agent_namespace", agent=~"$agent", gen_ai_response_model=~"$model"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Time per output token by model (p95)

panels.description: Rates from the data plane's HTTP metrics, scoped to the LLM listener. Provider errors and rate limits show up as non-2xx.
panels.title: Requests and errors on the LLM listener

panels.description: Exact — the model is priced. Unpriced — the model is in the catalog with no rate for a token type. Missing — the model is not in the catalog. NoCatalog — no catalog is configured at all, and no cost is recorded. Anything but Exact means the cost panels understate spend; fix it in llmRouting.modelCatalog.
panels.title: Cost catalog lookups by status

panels.description: Every model whose lookup did not resolve. Empty is the healthy state. Add the model to llmRouting.modelCatalog in the platform values.

targets.expr: sum by (gen_ai_request_model, gen_ai_response_model, status) (increase(agentgateway_cost_catalog_lookups_total{gateway=~"$gateway", agent_namespace=~"$agent_namespace", agent=~"$agent", status!="Exact"}[$__range])) > 0
